name: ChudoDerevo
source:
The main character is the only one who can get in the way of an inevitable man-made catastrophe. The short story tells the reader about the adventures of Pachomius and his friends. The dark side of the world of visual novels will open the door of the elevator rushing to meet the trials. The betrayal of comrades and gloomy behind-the-scenes intrigues are only the aftertaste of a beautiful shawarma, thoughts about which save the protagonist and direct him to his tomorrow. Permanent denouement is irreversible as is the fee that should be paid for each of your actions.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1182820/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一场人为灾难似乎已无可避免，主角却是唯一可能阻止它的人。这部短篇故事讲述了帕霍米及其朋友们的冒险。视觉小说世界的黑暗一面将敞开电梯门，带你飞速奔向考验。同伴的背叛与阴暗的幕后阴谋，不过是美味沙瓦玛卷饼留下的余味；而对这份美食的念想，拯救着主角，指引他走向明天。既定的结局无法逆转，正如你的每一个举动，都必须付出代价。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1182820/]Steam[/url]]
